Needs changes before merge. SAFETY-tier review: four blocking findings in the posted G-code.

Reviewed locally on trial merge `277d2774bdc190363f0f29a5023b3f32bc5d45cb`, against upstream main `893e749c09f5cd8b4253e72b9f3da047c562ebc3`. The first parent is the PR head. No GitHub runner was used.

### What looks good

- The post and machine have built-in entries and embedded assets.
- The new post pins, recorded outputs, app pins, and conformance tests pass.
- No existing NC or CL golden changed. I read all 26 new NC, refusal, and kit outputs line by line.

### Requested before merge

1. **[P1] Preserve the active spindle direction for cycle output.** `assets/posts/sinumerik-810m.cps:764` uses `spinRev`, but line 452 clears it after the spindle starts. My reverse FLOATINGTAP input emits `S100 M4`, then `R06=4 R07=3 R08=-4`, without warnings. R06 specifies the retract direction. The tap must retract with the opposite rotation. This output can break a left-hand tap. The same cleared state also sets the wrong R07 for reverse boring at line 771. Preserve the active direction. Add tests for forward and reverse cycles. See the [EMCO manual, D22](https://www.emco-world.com/fileadmin/user_upload/_Group/pics_products/Training_Software/software_manuals/Sinumerik_810_820/Sinumerik810820_Mill_en.pdf#page=52).

2. **[P1] Initialize R11 before each L84 call.** `assets/posts/sinumerik-810m.cps:762` does not set R11 in either tapping branch. L83 DEEP writes `R11=1`. My DEEP-then-TAP input then calls L84 without resetting that value or giving a warning. On the documented WinNC target, R11 selects the tapping axis. A retained value of 1 can select X instead of Z. Set the intended axis or the documented plane-selection value before L84. Add a DEEP-to-TAP transition test. The committed `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/synth_sinumerik-810m.nc:29` already contains this sequence; correct that golden too. See the [EMCO manual, D22](https://www.emco-world.com/fileadmin/user_upload/_Group/pics_products/Training_Software/software_manuals/Sinumerik_810_820/Sinumerik810820_Mill_en.pdf#page=52).

3. **[P1] Supply the L85 feed parameters.** `assets/posts/sinumerik-810m.cps:768` emits F but omits R16 and R17. The documented WinNC L85 uses R16 for cutting feed and R17 for retract feed. My REAM input emits `R02=1 R03=-10 R04=0 R10=4 F150`, then `L85 P1`, without warnings. Those two cycle feeds remain uncontrolled. Write both values, or refuse the unsupported cycle. Add assertions for both parameters. See the [EMCO manual, D23](https://www.emco-world.com/fileadmin/user_upload/_Group/pics_products/Training_Software/software_manuals/Sinumerik_810_820/Sinumerik810820_Mill_en.pdf#page=53).

4. **[P1] Make L86 lateral retraction deterministic.** `assets/posts/sinumerik-810m.cps:771` omits R12 and R13. The documented L86 uses these values for lateral retraction. My BORE input calls L86 without setting either parameter or giving a warning. Existing controller values can therefore cause an unintended rapid move. Initialize the intended offsets, or refuse this cycle until the required data is available. Add parameter assertions. See the [EMCO manual, D23](https://www.emco-world.com/fileadmin/user_upload/_Group/pics_products/Training_Software/software_manuals/Sinumerik_810_820/Sinumerik810820_Mill_en.pdf#page=53).

### Local build and test results

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS, 773 steps, 0 failed. The selected post and app builds with `--no-run` pass.
- `cargo clippy -j 32 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- The four independent output checks above fail. The post emits all four reproduction programs without warnings.

### Extra suites run

These full suites ran explicitly after the quick gate:

| Crate | Suite | Passed | Failed |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| camcraft-post | recorded_streams | 12 | 0 |
| camcraft-post | script_sinumerik_810m | 11 | 0 |
| camcraft-post | sinumerik_810m_post | 7 | 0 |
| camcraft-app | conformance | 7 | 0 |
| camcraft-app | sinumerik_810m_post | 3 | 0 |

The changed golden readers are covered by these suites. This PR changes no importer or UI code.

### Mutations and limits

- N9999 guard: original GREEN, raised limit RED, restored GREEN.
- Missing safe-retract guard: original GREEN, forced `safeZ()` return RED, restored GREEN.
- Each mutation used a temporary script copy outside the worktree. RED means the assertion for the required refusal failed.
- Removing `programUnits` still makes the engine refuse inch input. That removal did not reproduce a failing mutation.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects `app heavy: every target` because `posting_files.rs` changed. Heavy tests: **not run - owed to the wave run before merge**. This includes all 206 selected app heavy targets, with lib, bins, and doc. The dry run is not a test pass.
- Physical controller execution was not tested.
- File-size note: `posting_files.rs` and `machine.rs` gain entries while already above the file-size target. This note does not block the PR.

The worktree and review branch remain in place. No PR code or evidence was committed or pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: The four review findings have fixes in local commit `8968ea1bdac4dcb541b27160431975cd739468e1`. This commit is NOT pushed.

- Spindle direction: preserve the direction through the section. Pin: `cycles_preserve_forward_and_reverse_spindle_direction`.
- L84 axis: set `R11=3` before each call. Pin: `deep_to_tap_initializes_z_axis_before_every_l84`.
- L85 feeds: set `R16` and `R17`. Pin: `ream_initializes_cutting_and_retraction_feeds`.
- L86 offsets: set `R12=0` and `R13=0`. Pin: `bore_initializes_lateral_retraction_offsets`.

Each independent mutation failed its named pin. Each restore passed. The complete pin suite passed all four tests.

Validation on that local commit:

- Quick gate: 760 steps, 0 failed.
- Heavy gate: 204 steps, 0 failed.
- Clippy for post and app, all targets: passed.
- Post suites: 30 passed.
- App conformance: 7 passed. Example catalog: 37 passed, 4 ignored. App 810M suite: 3 passed.
- Golden regeneration changed only `tap_plate.nc` and `synth_sinumerik-810m.nc`. Both add `R11=3` before L84.

STOPPED: Main advanced during validation. The PR became conflicting. The required merge found a conflict in `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs`, in `header_notes_use_each_shipped_dialect_and_keep_the_full_surface_bound`.

The PR asserts:
```rust
assert_eq!(seen, 21, "every shipped post is checked");
```
Main replaces this logic with:
```rust
assert_eq!(text_posts, 20, "every shipped text post writes both notes");
assert_eq!(native_refusals, 1, "the native Agie dispatcher refused the notes");
```

The author-fix instructions require a stop when both sides change the same logic. I aborted the merge. No conflict resolution was guessed. No branch was pushed. The clean worktree `.claude/worktrees/fix-3317` retains the tested commit and build cache.

Please re-review after this conflict is resolved and the held commit is pushed.

Addressed: The owed heavy validation is complete. No code findings were fixed in this validation-only round.

heavy lanes green on e979c904092480ed087ba7aec90a391126b66f5b: 204 steps, all selected app heavy targets, including lib, bins, and doc.

The gate reported 0 failed steps. Known failures #1950 and #2849 failed as expected. Heavy example_catalog passed all 4 tests. Runtime was 45.5 minutes.

The run started against upstream base 6e641dac753020bfed49fec310237eed28448141. Upstream advanced to 64b7377297c95d1614c93835c1a1bef18c6de174 during execution. A subsequent dry run selected exactly the same 204 steps. Every selected step matched the completed logs.

The PR body now records the evidence under Heavy lanes. The head is unchanged. The worktree is clean and remains in place. No code, commit, merge, or push was made.

I did not add merge-ready. The latest review still requests four safety fixes: spindle direction, L84 axis selection, L85 feeds, and L86 retraction offsets. The PR also has conflicts. The draft state and existing labels remain unchanged.

Please re-review the validation evidence. The four code findings remain unresolved on this head.

Addressed all four safety findings from the latest review on new head `e4996c3cf6812760696a0f73b53194f4a8b86c55`.

1. **Preserve spindle direction for cycles (`assets/posts/sinumerik-810m.cps`):** Moved `spinRev = false` from `startPreamble()` to `endPreamble()`. Reverse floating tapping (`L84`) now emits `R06=3 R07=4`, reverse boring (`L86`) emits `R07=4`, and the next forward section resets to `M3` / `R07=3`. Pinned by `cycles_preserve_forward_and_reverse_spindle_direction` (mutation revert -> RED, restore -> GREEN).
2. **Initialize `R11` before every `L84` call (`assets/posts/sinumerik-810m.cps`):** Added `R11=3` (Z axis) to both rigid (`R08=-3`) and floating (`R08=-4`) `L84` parameter blocks so `L84` never inherits `R11=1` from `L83 DEEP`. Pinned by `deep_to_tap_initializes_z_axis_before_every_l84` (mutation revert -> RED, restore -> GREEN). Regenerated `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/sinumerik-810m/tap_plate.nc` and `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/synth_sinumerik-810m.nc`.
3. **Supply `L85` feed parameters (`assets/posts/sinumerik-810m.cps`):** Added `R16` (cutting feed) and `R17` (retraction feed) to the `L85` parameter block. Pinned by `ream_initializes_cutting_and_retraction_feeds` (mutation revert -> RED, restore -> GREEN).
4. **Make `L86` lateral retraction deterministic (`assets/posts/sinumerik-810m.cps`):** Added `R12=0` and `R13=0` to the `L86` parameter block. Pinned by `bore_initializes_lateral_retraction_offsets` (mutation revert -> RED, restore -> GREEN).

Validation on final head `e4996c3cf6812760696a0f73b53194f4a8b86c55` (base `upstream/main` `e313aa663869561b2748b9a0c5dac295470c8667`):
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test sinumerik_810m_post --test script_sinumerik_810m`: 11 + 11 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test conformance --test example_catalog --test sinumerik_810m_post`: 7 + 37 (4 ignored heavy) + 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: pass.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: GREEN, 759 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: GREEN, 204 steps, 0 failed (including `app heavy: example_catalog`).

Please re-review head `e4996c3cf6812760696a0f73b53194f4a8b86c55`.

Needs a branch refresh before merge. The four previous safety findings are fixed. No additional code blocker was found.

This is a SAFETY-tier re-review. I checked the latest earlier review first and read the author's Addressed comment.

### Earlier findings

All four fixes are in commit `e4996c3cf6812760696a0f73b53194f4a8b86c55`.

1. **Spindle direction: fixed.** `spinRev` now resets in `endPreamble()`. Pin: `cycles_preserve_forward_and_reverse_spindle_direction`.
2. **L84 axis: fixed.** Both tapping branches initialize `R11=3`. Pin: `deep_to_tap_initializes_z_axis_before_every_l84`.
3. **L85 feeds: fixed.** The parameter block initializes `R16` and `R17`. Pin: `ream_initializes_cutting_and_retraction_feeds`.
4. **L86 offsets: fixed.** The parameter block initializes `R12=0` and `R13=0`. Pin: `bore_initializes_lateral_retraction_offsets`.

All four pins passed locally. I checked the parameter meanings against the [EMCO manual, D22-D23](https://www.emco-world.com/fileadmin/user_upload/_Group/pics_products/Training_Software/software_manuals/Sinumerik_810_820/Sinumerik810820_Mill_en.pdf#page=52).

### Requested before merge

1. `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs:308`: resolve the merge conflict with current upstream main. The PR retains the `seen` assertion. Main uses `text_posts` and `native_refusals`. Preserve the 810M coverage and the native Agie refusal check. Run the affected checks on the resolved head.

The trial merge failed against `60376ccbbfa52305db6fa880278222e7854fcdbf`. I repeated it against newer main `b5ef7c39e9504ec67dca67f7727b916550d639d1`. The same file conflicts. I aborted both merges without resolving code. There is no trial-merge commit, so a first-parent check does not apply.

All results below are for the unchanged PR head alone. They do not validate a combined tree with current main. The current upstream `AGENTS.md` was the law used for this review.

### Local build and test results

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS, 759 steps, 0 failed, 67.7 minutes. The post and app test builds passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: PASS, 3 steps, 0 failed, 38.0 minutes. Both `motion light: lib` and `motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel` passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- No GitHub runner was used.

### Extra suites run

I ran these full suites explicitly after the quick gate.

| Crate | Suite | Passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| camcraft-post | recorded_streams | 12 | 0 | 0 |
| camcraft-post | script_sinumerik_810m | 11 | 0 | 0 |
| camcraft-post | sinumerik_810m_post | 11 | 0 | 0 |
| camcraft-app | conformance | 7 | 0 | 0 |
| camcraft-app | example_catalog | 37 | 0 | 4 |
| camcraft-app | example_catalog_adaptive | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| camcraft-app | example_catalog_edge_work | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| camcraft-app | sinumerik_810m_post | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| camcraft-app | solid_law_goldens | 7 | 0 | 0 |

These cover the changed golden readers. This PR changes no importer or UI code. The extra kernel importer suites do not apply.

### Mutations and goldens

I independently repeated all four safety mutations through the post CLI. Each check used a script copy and input under `/tmp`.

- Reset `spinRev` after spindle start: original GREEN, mutation RED, restore GREEN.
- Remove `R11=3` from L84: original GREEN, mutation RED, restore GREEN.
- Remove L85 `R16` and `R17`: original GREEN, mutation RED, restore GREEN.
- Remove L86 `R12=0` and `R13=0`: original GREEN, mutation RED, restore GREEN.

RED means the required output assertion failed. Each program ran without warnings. No PR file was changed for a mutation.

I read both moved goldens line by line. `tap_plate.nc` and `synth_sinumerik-810m.nc` each add only `R11=3` before L84. The body lists both changes under Goldens moved. The earlier review covers the other new outputs.

### Heavy evidence and limits

The [author's current-head record](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3317#issuecomment-7087717736) reports 204 heavy steps and 0 failed steps. It names head `e4996c3cf6812760696a0f73b53194f4a8b86c55` and base `e313aa663869561b2748b9a0c5dac295470c8667`. The base was less than 24 hours old during this review. The record covers all selected app heavy targets, including lib, bins, doc, and `app heavy: example_catalog`.

I retain that evidence for the exact PR head and did not repeat its full heavy run. My heavy dry run also selects 204 steps. The dry run is not a pass. Main has changed since the recorded base. No heavy result certifies the combined tree with current main, because the trial merge conflicts.

Physical controller execution was not tested.

### Review state

The old `needs-rework` label is no longer required for the four safety findings on this new head. Retain `conflicts`. Do not add `merge-ready`. The PR stays a draft while it conflicts.

The clean worktree `.claude/worktrees/review-3317` and branch `review-3317` remain in place. No code or review evidence was committed or pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge-time refresh: **DELTA** (`cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 3317 --reviewed e4996c3cf`). Head `e4590154c` is one merge of main (`f81bcac8c`).

Delta review: the merging session read `git show --remerge-diff e4590154c`; a separate agent did the refresh. There is one hand edit, a test-only literal in `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs`:
- It keeps main's `text_posts` / `native_refusals` split.
- The text-post count is 24. The merged tree has 25 `.cps` files: 24 text posts plus `agie-native`, which is main's 23 text posts plus this PR's `sinumerik-810m`.

No product code changed in the merge. `git diff upstream/main --stat` lists only the PR's own 38 files. The refresher's runs on the merged tree all passed:
- camcraft-post: comment_escape 4, script_sinumerik_810m 11, sinumerik_810m_post 11, folder_scan 2, and clippy on camcraft-post is clean.
- camcraft-app: conformance 7, machine 33, posting 17, shipped_from_disk 3, sinumerik_810m_post 3.

The review of `e4996c3cf` stands. Flagging ready and merging now.

Route note. The merge route is the coordinator's. Another session merged this PR (merge commit `dac6a896b`). No second safety read and no trial merge ran here: the owner's order at this time limits our work to `P4` and `P5`. The post-merge run of `dac6a896b` is the check of the tip. A red run opens the issue for main.
